meta.units: mm, plan coords from floor_plan.json (x right, y down the page)
meta.source: Owner's sketches (2026-11-06) for WC1 and WC2 + Alantz ceiling ventilator/light screenshot.
meta.wc1: Interior x 11235 (party wall face) - 13500 (east wall face), y 4525 (door wall face) - 6305 (window wall face). Sink + toilet on the party wall, bi-fold door x 11950-12650, window x 11880-12680, shower in the SE corner.
meta.wc2: Interior x 9170 (duct wall face) - 11085 (party wall face), y 4525 - 6305. Bi-fold door x 9240-9940 (NW), toilet on the party wall (north), sink on the south wall (west), shower on the party wall (south).

half_wall.note: WC1 shower half wall (owner's sketch): 800 long off the window wall, 150 thick, cement + tiled to 1200 high, frosted glass panel above to 2000. Sits just east of the window, so the window stays out of the shower.

niches.note: Two tiled recessed niches (320 W x 300 H x 90 D) on the shower side for shampoo + body wash, at 800-1100 high.

showers.note: Rain shower set on the window wall in the SE corner (behind the half wall), shower zone ~665 W x 800 D, open to the north.
Rain shower set on the party wall, south end (owner's sketch), clear of the toilet at the north end.

fan_lights.why: Centre of the room's free floor between the toilet and the shower: lights the whole WC, ~1 m from the shower head so it dries the wet area without sitting in the spray, >= 900 from every wall for the air to circulate, clear of the bi-fold door (folds near the north wall) and the half wall.
Centre of WC2: between the toilet (NE), sink (SW) and shower (SE), ~1 m from the shower head, clear of the bi-fold door in the NW corner.

fan_light.note: Alantz-style ceiling ventilator + LED light (~300 dia, ~160 deep, sizes assumed - check the model's spec). Surface-mounted on the ceiling slab, needs a switched power point above the ceiling position.

wc1_shower.note: WC1 from the door: window, half wall, niches, shower

wc1_room.note: WC1 from the NE corner: toilet, sink, window, ventilator

wc2_room.note: WC2 from the door corner: toilet, shower, ventilator
